verification.note: Glob of docs/process/reviews/fix-hydration-418-narrow/** returns only decisions.md and r1/* (head.txt, expected.txt, classification.json, fixes.txt, product-files.txt, test-files.txt). There is no invariants.md and no spec. r1/product-files.txt lists frontend/src/hooks/useFocusMode.ts and frontend/src/hooks/useIsMobile.ts. The test file frontend/src/hooks/__tests__/viewportHydration.test.tsx exists at HEAD. The changed regions match the claim: useIsMobile.ts:3-22 (now useSyncExternalStore) and useFocusMode.ts:6 (import) and :65-71 (isWideNow/serverIsWide/useIsWideViewport).

Old code, read from the main checkout at /Users/libre/Sources/video_share, which I take to be the pre-change state: useIsMobile used useState(getIsMobile) at :18, and useIsWideViewport used a useState initializer that read window.innerWidth >= MOBILE_BREAKPOINT at useFocusMode.ts:67-71. On the client, the first commit therefore always held complementary real values, because w<768 and w>=768 are exact complements. New code: useIsMobile.ts:13 serverIsMobile=()=>false and useFocusMode.ts:66 serverIsWide=()=>false, both passed to useSyncExternalStore (:21, :70). React's hydration render uses getServerSnapshot. The snapshot-changed check that forces a sync re-render runs from a passive effect, so the hydration commit's layout effects and ref callbacks see isMobile=false together with wide=false, which is a desktop-but-narrow combination the old hooks could not produce on the client. Consumers confirmed by grep: FileDetailShell.tsx:123 and :218, ShellLayout.tsx:202 (useLayoutEffect) and :399-411, useInspectorFit.ts:97-120, useFindInFile.ts:80-81, MarkdownDocumentLayout.tsx:64 and :100, AppShell.tsx:121, TwoPaneLayout.tsx:111, TreeToggle.tsx:26, Header.tsx:68, ChromeButtons.tsx:56, InboxView.tsx:49, FileDetailChrome.tsx:54 and FileDetailSkeleton.tsx:63. FileDetailContainer.tsx:78 is a further consumer that the finding does not list. None of these files is in r1/product-files.txt. I did not run the app to observe a user-visible effect of the transient state.

specification_compliance: No spec or invariants file exists for this change; decisions.md records an in-app run at 429966bbb showing no React #418 at 390/700/1440 px.
potential_unspecified_behavior: During the hydration commit, every consumer receives isMobile=false and wide=false at the same time; the code does not specify whether layout effects in the consumers (ShellLayout useLayoutEffect, useInspectorFit, MarkdownDocumentLayout split→preview effect) behave correctly in that state.
regression_risks: Layout effects or ref callbacks in consumers may act once on the transient desktop-narrow state before the forced sync re-render, for example measuring the inspector in the desktop form on a phone.
test_coverage: viewportHydration.test.tsx checks for no recoverable errors and the final text at 390/700/1440 px; it does not check intermediate commits or consumer layout effects.
